copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 装上 Google Chat 通道：从 channels 分支复制适配器与注册测试，追加一行注册导入，安装 @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0，再构建并跑集成测试。产出已注册的 gchat 适配器。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 接入 Google Chat（团队 space 或与机器人的私信）时使用。凭据与 webhook 配好后，跑 /manage-channels 把该通道接到某个 agent group。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Google Chat 通道
say.note: 复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 把 Google Chat 空间接到我的 agent group
Google Chat 消息收不到，帮我查 webhook
say.note: 检查 endpoint URL 与隧道是否对得上

howto.what_en: Adds a Google Chat channel to NanoClaw: copies the adapter and its registration test from the channels branch, adds the registration import, installs @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0, then builds and runs one integration test. Result: a compiling, registered gchat adapter.
howto.when_en: Use when you want NanoClaw to talk over Google Chat (team spaces or DMs to the bot). After credentials and the webhook are set up, run /manage-channels to wire it to an agent group.

say_en.text: Add the Google Chat channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs the test

say_en.text: Wire my Google Chat space to my agent group
Google Chat messages aren't arriving - check the webhook
say_en.note: Checks the endpoint URL and tunnel match
